verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains nothing about Zulip's free-tier limits or whether older message history stays accessible on a free plan. The plans and self-hosting pages cited only cover export/import portability and the same software being available for self-hosting, which is adjacent and does not address history retention on a free tier.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can keep my team on a free tier without losing access to older message history
